sources.snippet: About What SZL Holdings is SZL Holdings builds governed-AI infrastructure with inspectable source, bounded decision logic, and linked evidence. Its Lean corpus has an explicitly mixed proof posture: locked formulas are identified separately from open sorry -tagged obligations, and Lambda remains a conjecture rather than a theorem.
